mina: Bluejay just pushed two adapters + a tiny tokenizer remap into intake. Can we run a short compatibility/sanity sprint (float32/int8/int4) and produce a minimal repro if anything breaks?

rob: Yes. Base model is gptx-7b-cust. Adapter order: small-dialog.lora then cust-instruct.lora. Tokenizer change = adds <BJ_TOK> and remaps digits 0-4 into a compact range.

safiya: Note: remapping digits previously caused multi-token splits in some locales. Watch token splits + embeddings.

mina: Sprint checklist: token roundtrip diffs, per-prompt top-1 prob diffs (flag >0.15), KL per-token, embeddings cos-delta vs ref vectors, regen A/B on 24 prompts (dialog/instruct/numeric). Include a KV warmstart run.

rob: Local command I'm running:
```
ci-run --model gptx-7b-cust \
  --adapters small-dialog.lora,cust-instruct.lora \
  --tokenizer-patch bluejay_map.json \
  --quants float32,int8,int4 \
  --prompts quick_sprint_prompts.json \
  --warm-prefix "[ws]" \
  --collect token_probs,embeddings \
  --out s3://ci/bluejay/3309012345/
```

ci-bot: Job queued: job/bluejay-sanity-sprint-3309012345

ci-bot: Job started -> setup -> running evals

ci-bot: Job finished: SUCCESS. Artifacts: s3://ci/bluejay/3309012345/results.zip

rob: Quick artifacts summary: two prompts show large top-1 shifts float32->int4: prompt_04 (0.30) and prompt_19 (0.18). Both are numeric-heavy. Embedding cos sim on numeric subset: mean 0.95 (float32) -> 0.86 (int4). KL spikes localized to remapped digit tokens.

safiya: Token roundtrip check shows digits "3" and "4" now split into two tokens in patched tokenizer. That explains the probability/embedding shifts.

mina: Triage plan: 1) recommend int8 as temporary fallback for production; 2) ask Bluejay for tokenizer remap that preserves single-token digits or provide a pretokenize remap option; 3) produce minimal repro bundle (prompts 04 and 19 + tokenized traces) and attach artifacts.

rob: Uploaded repro bundle and token traces: s3://ci/bluejay/3309012345/repro_bundle.tar.gz

ci-bot: Artifact uploaded: s3://ci/bluejay/3309012345/repro_bundle.tar.gz

raj: I'll draft a short customer note summarizing findings, attach the repro, and recommend int8 until token fix is available. ETA: I'm pinging Bluejay for their tokenizer revision.
